items.title: Record U.S. cyclosporiasis outbreak is over, CDC says
items.description: The largest outbreak, linked to shredded iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms, sickened more than 12,000 people.

items.title: Analysis: Hot CPI puts Kevin Warsh’s Fed credibility on the line before rate decision
items.description: August CPI data leaves Kevin Warsh to choose between acting on his inflation warnings or risking new doubts about his control of the central bank.

items.title: Iran, Russia condemn Western economic sanctions and urge BRICS bloc to deepen economic ties
items.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Russian President Vladimir Putin criticized Western sanctions and asked the BRICS bloc to deepen trade ties.

items.title: Here’s the inflation breakdown for August 2026 — in one chart
items.description: Inflation remained stubbornly high in August, largely on the back of higher energy prices amid the Iran war, economists said.

items.title: Houthis reportedly advance to key Red Sea island, further threatening crucial oil choke point
items.description: The advance raises the threat to shipping near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a waterway that connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden to global markets.

items.title: Oil prices fall after double-digit weekly gains above $100
items.description: The decline snapped multi-day winning streaks for both Brent and WTI crude oil futures.

items.title: The oil shock is testing private credit borrowers already burdened by high debt costs
items.description: Oil near $100 could further squeeze leveraged private credit borrowers as investors weigh the risk that inflation could push interest rates higher again.

items.title: Trump dismisses AI extinction risks as more than a dozen OpenAI, Anthropic insiders call for a slowdown
items.description: Trump said he isn't concerned AI could cause human extinction as researchers at leading AI companies warn about rapid advances and lawmakers propose safeguards.

items.title: Trump says he has no regrets about starting the Iran war as U.S. dials up economic pressure
items.description: Speaking to Fox News presenter Laura Ingraham, Trump said that he would have attacked Iran despite the impact on the midterm elections.

items.title: Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness is active in options market, sources say
items.description: Situational Awareness has been buying options positions in stocks including Advanced Micro Devices, Bloom Energy and Coreweave, sources told CNBC's David Faber.

items.title: UAE plans $46 billion investment in Germany, with data centers a key focus
items.description: The UAE plans to invest 40 billion euros ($46.4 billion) in Germany, with data center infrastructure a key part of the package.

items.title: AI regulation calls grow in D.C. after researcher's extinction warning
items.description: Members of Congress are calling for AI regulation after a researcher warned that OpenAI and Anthropic are acting irresponsibly.

items.title: Oracle's stock rises on earnings and revenue beat fueled by AI cloud demand
items.description: Oracle's cloud infrastructure revenue jumped 121% from a year earlier, reflecting demand for AI cloud services.

items.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Friday
items.description: Stocks are still looking at a higher open after consumer inflation, excluding food and energy prices, came in hotter than expected.

items.title: Treasury yields remain near multi-year highs as August CPI shows sticky inflation
items.description: Treasury yields remained near multiyear highs as investors weighed the impact of the latest consumer price report for August.

items.title: Nonprofit received $2 million from Olivia Rodrigo and Melinda French Gates—it wants to give cash to abuse survivors
items.description: The money nonprofit Freefrom received from participating in Olivia Rodrigo's Daisy Chain Music Festival helped the organization hit its annual finacial goal.

items.title: Wealthy investors are pouring billions into this new tax strategy despite risks
items.description: Total assets invested in so-called tax-aware long-short strategies — or TALS — have surged to more than $170 billion, according to Tax Alpha Insider.

items.title: Bessent says 'a large bank' will be sanctioned on Monday as part of Iran strategy
items.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said a large bank would be sanctioned next week.

items.title: Sub-$100 smartphones becoming a rarity as AI memory prices soar
items.description: The days of the sub-$100 smartphone may be numbered, including in China.

items.title: U.S. diesel price tops $6 per gallon, a record high as Ukraine and Iran wars ripple through economy
items.description: U.S. diesel prices hit their highest level ever as fuel supply disruption stemming from the Ukraine and Iran wars lifts transportation costs.
